title: Explicitly authorized home-host owner canary
description: Run only for an owner who has explicitly authorized a disposable VM canary on their prepared host. Authenticate that owner in an isolated browser before this case; do not change the QA account or transfer host records/keys between owners.

requires.ownerAuthorization: Explicit authorization for a disposable canary under the supplied ownerUid and ready hostId; authenticate through Firebase in a fresh isolated browser, keeping all tokens in memory and out of artifacts
requires.preparedHost: Matching helper/image installed, pinned host fingerprint, managed SSH readiness passed
requires.cleanup: Stop the session and permanently delete only the newly created canary workspace through the application; verify guest/disk absence afterward

steps.expected: The isolated browser Firebase user UID matches ownerUid, and the supplied ready remoteHostId belongs to that owner. Record initial host capacity and managed resource inventory.
The embedded pi-web-ui native terminal opens; write a sentinel and install a harmless user-scoped tool. Verify both after browser reconnect and after a stop/start cycle.
Exercise duplicate mutation, lost response, SSH/gateway interruption and offline deletion recovery only on the canary; record operation IDs and safe status without logging credentials.
Confirm the canary domain, disk and seed are absent, capacity is released, and unrelated resources match the initial inventory. Sign out and remove the owned browser profile.
